description: This file contains a lexical analyzer (lexer) implementation for a custom query language called VTQL, including token definitions, state management, and parsing functions. It defines the VTQL_Lexer class and related functions for tokenizing SQL-like statements.

classes.name: VTQL_Lexer
classes.description: A lexer class responsible for tokenizing VTQL query strings, managing states, and handling different token types such as keywords, operators, and symbols.

methods.name: incrementN
methods.description: Advances the lexer's state multiple times.

methods.name: incState
methods.description: Increments the current state of the lexer and updates mandatory flag.

methods.name: handlecolumn_list
methods.description: Processes the column list part of the query, handling '*' and specific column names.

methods.name: handletable
methods.description: Processes the table name section of the query.

methods.name: handlewhere
methods.description: Handles the 'where' clause, including operators and logical connectors.

methods.name: handleend
methods.description: Detects the end of a query statement.
